clips.title: The story
paras: In Darnassus, a young druid returns to complete Power over Poison. The Cenarion Circle's trial began in Darkshore, where the initiate learned to brew a remedy by hand.

In Darkshore, Alanndarian Nightsong asks young druids to gather Earthroot and Lunar Fungus by hand. They brew a salve to heal stricken wildlife. Before granting the magic to purge toxins, the Cenarion Circle wants initiates to know the hardship of treating poison without spiritual aid. The work teaches them what common folk face when venom strikes, and why a druid must meet their suffering with care.

After the remedy proves effective in Auberdine, Starblaze sends the druid across the sea to Darnassus. Mathrengyl Bearwalker awaits in the Cenarion Enclave. Pleased with the initiate's grace under pressure, he teaches the art of cleansing toxins through nature's power. But virulent poisons in the wilds around Auberdine trouble him, for they point to an unnatural blight disturbing the land's balance.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You've learned what it means to cure poison without the benefit of spiritual aid. Remember what others must endure in fighting poisonous afflictions as you soon embrace your newfound power over poison.
You should now return to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus, friend. He, no doubt, has a very important spell to teach you now that the student understands the lesson given unto them.
Farewell, young druid. We shall speak again.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Welcome back - I've been following your progress on this lesson since you left, and I must admit I was surprised to learn about the situation in Auberdine. This does bear some further investigation, as the introduction of such poisons into the environment is most upsetting to the balance.
You handled yourself with grace under pressure. For that, I can find no better way to reward you than with permanent power over poison. Use it well, friend... Use it well.
